description: Short realistic smoke suite for installation and regression checks.
notes: Use this suite after plugin code changes.
It samples multiple domains while keeping session history short.

cases.goal: Simulate a writer revising an internal release note workflow after a small audience-specific change.
turns: Draft a terse 3-step checklist for publishing a release note to technical users. Output numbered lines only.
Keep the same checklist, but replace the final step with 'post to the internal changelog'. Output only the updated checklist.

cases.goal: Simulate a developer spotting a bug and then tightening the fix after a local requirement change.
turns: Review this function and name the bug in one sentence: function normalizeName(name){ return name.trim().toLowerCase(); }
Same function, but now it must also return an empty string for null or undefined input. Give a one-sentence fix.

cases.goal: Simulate a researcher updating a conclusion after one contradictory evidence item arrives.
turns: Assume an internal memo claims release date A. Give one sentence on what evidence would matter most before repeating the claim.
New evidence now contradicts the memo and supports release date B instead. Update your conclusion in one sentence.
